### 1. User intent and staged interaction

Agent locates Cedar Quay, separately asks email; she supplies d4-priya@cedarquay.example. Actual verification returns “Identity verified.” Agent asks source references; she gives CQ-ACH-0831 and CQ-REFUND-MAX. She has already filed the authorization; no agent signature is inferred. When necessary account work is explained she responds “Yes, you can do that for me.” She does not suggest hidden prerequisites.

August ended, posted exports and completed reconciliation exist, the active 1 Gbps holding has unchanged US East, untaxed and approved tax attributes and no negotiated price. No outside work is required by these immediate internal interfaces. Completed bank-confirmed ACH principal and pending exact refund request exist. Minimum cash refund is USD 1.

### 4. Calculations
Review: full-month allowance 10000 GB, standard unit rate 0.067, review reduction min(network 0.04,support 0.04)=0.04. max(20000−10000,0)×0.067=670; 670×0.96=643.20 approved corrected net. No tax.
Correction: source 660 plus prior signed correction net 0 minus approved target 643.20 gives 16.80 overcharge; support cap 660×0.04=26.40; negate min(16.80,26.40) → −16.80. Round once half-up to two decimals; no tax.
Refund: opening posted receivable 660−680+historical zero=−20; after correction −36.80. Credit magnitude 36.80, remaining original principal max(680−0,0)=680; support payment bound 680×0.04=27.20. min(36.80,680,27.20)=27.20, above minimum 1; final half-up two decimals. Posting +27.20 leaves receivable −9.60 retained on account, same original ACH destination. Review and evidence rows never contribute to financial balance.

### 6. Discovered problem tree and counter-proof
Root payout → assisted correction → completed approved rate-error assessment → already completed aggregate reconciliation. Each arrow points from blocked action to required action. “Before paying an assisted overpayment refund, post the assisted correction for the source charge paid by that payment” (assisted overpayment payout handling, Handling condition) excludes the natural wrong answer of refunding only the initial USD 20 credit. Finder returns no correction at opening. “Before an assisted correction is posted, complete the source rate-error review and use its approved corrected subtotal” (assisted correction posting handling) excludes skipping review; finder returns selected review status pending and net 0. The corrected assessment handling interface completes that review, and source evidence reviews says source and evidence must identify the same narrowest object. Completed reconciliation already meets this leaf. After assessment actual approved review has 643.20; correction then creates a posted negative amount; refund then pays.
Visible monthly aggregate export scope says “sum posted primary internet outbound transfer meter volume ... in the original charge's source billing month”; qualifying scope says “legacy locator does not restrict this aggregate charge to that export alone.” This excludes single-export 2500 GB and zero-target alternatives. Original charge period excludes using review timestamp as service month. Exact source prior-correction and payment-return clauses exclude unrelated historical rows; negative signed receivable basis excludes gross-only or absolute-sum balance. Review price reduction excludes stacking promotion/portfolio reductions; signed correction formula excludes refunding the whole overcharge cap without comparing actual overcharge. Payout maximum excludes all USD 36.80 and the USD 680 principal-only candidate. Existing approved source tax excludes tax uplift. No waiting clause supports delay.
